subject: Multiple Group Analysis with some items only answered in one group

messages.author: 50e6dacfb9b442ae
messages.subject: Multiple Group Analysis with some items only answered in one group
parts:
Hi,
I would like to examine a questionnaire about basic psychological needs for measurement invariance in two groups (people in a partnership, singles). The questionnaire contains some items which were answered only by one of the groups, because they do not apply to the other group (relationship quality in a partnership). All these items load together with more general items regarding social needs on one factor.

After setting up the model and calculating the MSA, I got the following error message: lavaan ERROR: data contains no observations in group 2

Setting the loadings for the missing items in group two to 0 also resulted in the same error.

Do you have any suggestions?

parts:
Sure, here is my syntax:

mod_sem <- '
 KS =~ KO_04 + KO_06 + KO_08 + KO_09 + KO_11 + KO_12
        + SW_02 + SW_03 + SW_04 + SW_05 + SW_06 + SW_07 + SW_08 + SW_09 + SW_10 + SW_11
        + LU_08
        + KN_01 + KN_ 07 + KN_08 + KN_09
 B =~ KO_03
        + BA_03 + BA_05 + BA_06 + BA_07 + BA_09 + BA_10 + BA_12
        + c(NA,0)*BP_02 + c(NA,0)*BP_03 + c(NA,0)*BP_04 + c(NA,0)*BP_05 + c(NA,0)*BP_06
        + c(NA,0)*BP_07 + c(NA,0)*BP_08 + c(NA,0)*BP_09 + c(NA,0)*BP_11
 WG =~ KO_05 + KO_10
        + LU_01 + LU_05 + LU_06 + LU_07 + LU_09 + LU_10 + LU_11
        + KN_02 + KN_03 + KN_04 + KN_06

KS ~~ B
KS ~~ WG
B ~~ WG'

fit_sem_MSA <- sem(mod_sem, data = data, group = "REL_STAT",
                   group.equal = c("loadings"),
                   group.partial = c("B =~ BP_02", "B =~ BP_03", "B =~ BP_04", "B =~ BP_05", "B =~ BP_06",
                                     "B =~ BP_07", "B =~ BP_08", "B =~ BP_09", "B =~ BP_11"))

The items BP were only answered by group 1.

I would be very happy if someone could help.
